headline: Dorgu's nod settles eight-goal argument
deck: Manchester United and Aston Villa drew 4-4

reports.standfirst: Manchester United came back from two down to draw 4-4 with Aston Villa.
reports.account:
Alysson put Aston Villa ahead in the 1st minute, converting John McGinn's pass left-footed from inside the box. Nicolas Jackson doubled the lead at a set piece, a right-footed finish from close range in the 4th minute. Bruno Fernandes pulled one back from the penalty spot after 16 minutes, his kick going down the middle. Youri Tielemans levelled just before half-time with a left-footed shot inside the box from Noussair Mazraoui's pass.
McGinn restored Villa's lead early in the second half, sending a left-footed penalty low into the corner. Leon Goretzka made it 4-2 after 53 minutes, a left-footed finish low inside the corner from close range off Jackson's set-piece pass. Joshua Zirkzee, on for Bryan Mbeumo, made it 4-3 two minutes into stoppage time, converting a cross from fellow substitute Patrick Dorgu left-footed. Dorgu, on for Diogo Dalot, then headed in Fernandes's corner from close range deep into stoppage time.

sections.head: Alysson strikes first
sections.pitch: Alysson now has two league goals this season, and the opener came from one of his three shots. He also earned one defensive point.

sections.head: Dorgu's goal and assist
sections.pitch: Patrick Dorgu came off the bench to have a hand in both of Manchester United's late goals, the only substitute in the match to make one and score one.

sections.head: Goretzka scores Villa's fourth
sections.pitch: Leon Goretzka scored Aston Villa's fourth and final goal, the one that put them two in front for a second time before Manchester United replied twice.

reports.standfirst: Brighton & Hove Albion beat Brentford 2-0, adding a second after Igor Thiago was sent off.
reports.account: Diego Gómez put Brighton ahead after 15 minutes, his left-footed shot from outside the box finding the top corner. Igor Thiago received his marching orders eight minutes after Gómez's goal, leaving Brentford with 10 men. Pascal Groß doubled the lead against 10 men in the 42nd minute, converting from the spot right-footed into the top corner.

sections.head: Groß creates openings
sections.pitch: Pascal Groß's goal took him to four in the league this term, with five chances also created for Brighton.
sections.stake: AtleticoTimHortons has him, for eight points, and drew 40-40 with The Raccoons.

sections.head: Vuskovic, Dunk unbreached
sections.pitch: Luka Vuskovic and Lewis Dunk were on from first whistle to last without Brighton conceding, and Dunk collected a defensive point too.
sections.stake: The Truffle Pigs has Vuskovic, for nine points; Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza has Dunk, for six points, and lost 48-43 to The Truffle Pigs.

keyStats.label: Points
keyStats.value: Vuskovic 9 (The Truffle Pigs), Gómez 8 (Cowthenbeef), Groß 8 (AtleticoTimHortons), Verbruggen 6 (Cowthenbeef)

reports.standfirst: Liverpool win 3-1 at Crystal Palace, Alexis Mac Allister's header opening the scoring.
reports.account: Alexis Mac Allister put Liverpool ahead after 40 minutes, heading Dominik Szoboszlai's set-piece cross through the middle from inside the area. Florian Wirtz added a second after 54 minutes, finishing Bradley Barcola's cross right-footed and low inside the post. Alexander Isak struck a third one minute from time, converting Wirtz's pass on the break with his right foot through the centre. Eddie Nketiah, on from the bench for Jørgen Strand Larsen, replied deep into added time with a right-footed penalty into the bottom corner.

sections.head: Szoboszlai's six chances
sections.pitch: Dominik Szoboszlai created six chances in all across the match, his set-piece delivery for Liverpool's opening goal being one of them.
sections.stake: domeitalycoach has him on the bench, for six points, and lost 38-37 to If anyone can, Bannan can.

sections.head: Mac Allister, Barcola deliver
sections.pitch: Alexis Mac Allister was paid the maximum two defensive points and had three shots. Bradley Barcola matched him with three shots of his own.
sections.stake: its_ohi has Mac Allister, for eight points; Bayern Bru has Barcola, for five points, and lost 55-30 to its_ohi.

keyStats.label: Points
keyStats.value: Wirtz 11 (domeitalycoach), Mac Allister 8 (its_ohi), Isak 6 (GlengarryHearts), Araujo 6 (The Truffle Pigs)

reports.standfirst: AFC Bournemouth won 2-1 at Ipswich Town, with Evanilson scoring early on.
reports.account: Evanilson put AFC Bournemouth ahead after five minutes, his right-footed shot from inside the six-yard box going low beside the post. Leif Davis turned the ball into his own net just after half-time for 2-0. Jack Clarke, introduced for Jaden Philogene, scored from the spot with 17 minutes left, his right-footed kick going along the ground into the corner.

sections.head: Evanilson's fifth league goal
sections.pitch: Evanilson's opener was his fifth league goal of the campaign and the first of four shots he had in the match.
sections.stake: If anyone can, Bannan can has him, for seven points.

sections.head: Clarke converts, Christie shoots
sections.pitch: Jack Clarke's goal from the bench was his second of the league season. Ryan Christie tried three shots for AFC Bournemouth.
sections.stake: Clarke, a free agent, five points; Christie, a free agent, six points.

keyStats.label: Points
keyStats.value: Evanilson 7 (If anyone can, Bannan can), Christie 6, Clarke 5, Ouattara 4

reports.standfirst: Sunderland beat Chelsea 1-0 with Enzo Le Fée's first-half penalty but stay in the bottom three.
reports.account: Granit Xhaka went off injured in the 4th minute. Brian Brobbey met Chemsdine Talbi's cross from close range after 15 minutes, his shot going off target. Enzo Le Fée put Sunderland ahead after 36 minutes, converting from the spot, low and right-footed into the corner.

sections.head: Mukiele keeps clean sheet
sections.pitch: Nordi Mukiele was on the pitch from start to finish without Sunderland conceding, and the league paid him one defensive point.
sections.stake: GlengarryHearts has him on the bench, for seven points, and lost 48-41 to Cowthenbeef.

sections.head: Le Fée's third strike
sections.pitch: Enzo Le Fée's goal was his third of the league campaign, and alongside it he earned one point for his effort at the back.
sections.stake: GlengarryHearts has him, for nine points.
